scope: Static source inventory and cache-marker existence snapshot. No scenes or compute modules imported, no rendering or computation.

instruction_files.method: find excluding .git and .venv; rg --files --hidden for AGENTS.md and SKILL.md; /workspace/.agents is empty

limitations: Cache JSON presence is only the documented completion marker; no schema, provenance, freshness, array integrity or model-weight validity is established.

Only directly imported load functions, compute.load aliases and literal _result(module,item) calls are resolved; dynamic names, imported helpers, custom cache loaders and transitive computation dependencies can add requirements.
All calls in a listed scene module are scanned, including helper functions that a scene may not execute; this is static evidence, not a minimal execution dependency graph.
common.py helper literal reads are listed separately because call reachability is not established; the final scoreboard in Part31 conditionally omits unavailable earlier rows.
Narration estimate matches tools/lecture_length.py source algorithm: 140 English words/minute, literal strings plus 3 words per f-string placeholder; dynamically assembled prose can be undercounted.
Chinese duration is not measured. Doubling English duration is a planning assumption, not verified playback time.
Cache snapshot was captured while root owned sequential Part1 computation; caches can change after this timestamp.
All source files parsed are hashed; uncommitted fixes are included. This inventory does not assert visual, factual, animation, audio or playback QA.
